correctness.rationale: For rooted three-level tree posets, surjectivity forces the root image and the p-morphism equation sends every maximal source leaf to a maximal target leaf. Each source center either collapses with all its leaves onto one of L target leaves or maps to target center j with its leaves surjecting onto the t_j leaves, in A_ij=t_j! S(s_i,t_j) ways. Independent center factors give the multivariate polynomial; using every target center is necessary and sufficient for global back-surjectivity, yielding the stated inclusion–exclusion. Checked r,k>=1, positive sizes, no claim for omitted-center coefficients. Independent literal image-and-upset enumeration agreed with formula on four small irregular/zero cases; those do not prove arbitrary lengths.
residual_risks: The matching feasibility criterion is already established prior work, not original; no claim for other tree depths or unlabeled quotient classes.
